name: Horn Blast
description:
You blow a blast on your hunting horn, which can be heard up to a mile away. Choose one of the following effects, each of which persist for 1 round:

  • Each ally within far range takes +1d to their next skill check.

  • Each foe within far range takes -1d to their next skill check.

  • All creatures within far range do not provoke attacks of opportunity.

Choose each effect once per rest.

Describe your horn and its sound.

improvements.name: Call to Arms
improvements.description: Once per Quest, you may use this ability instead of rolling initiative.
